note: Naming: 2016-2018 'Santa Fe' = 3-row LWB (SE/Limited/Ultimate packages, ~$30k+), while the 2-row 'Santa Fe Sport' was a separate model. For 2019 the new 2-row Santa Fe took the name and the old 3-row became 'Santa Fe XL' (2019 only). So 2016-2018 rows here are NOT the predecessor of the 2019+ 2-row trims; a used '2017 Santa Fe Sport' should not be valued off these rows. Rows are FWD prices; AWD premium in each row's note. Hybrid / Plug-in Hybrid variants not included.
